overall_notes: The paper focuses on Retrieval Question Answering (ReQA) using a pluggable adapter (PRCA) to improve black-box LLM performance. Key findings: 1) The paper does use automatic metrics (ROUGE-L) during training, contrary to the original extraction. 2) Human evaluation was conducted alongside GPT-4 evaluation. 3) The methodology is robust with 75 different configurations tested across 3 datasets. 4) PRCA shows significant improvements (up to 20%) on complex QA tasks.
